meta.name: data-governance
meta.description: Establishes ownership, definitions, quality, access, and lineage for the organization's data. Use this when metrics disagree between teams, when nobody knows which dataset is authoritative, when setting up data ownership or access policy, when data quality is unreliable, or before opening a dataset to a wider audience.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清数据归属与口径,让指标对齐可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队常为数据口径争吵,却找不到权威数据源
copy.tagline_en: Clarify data ownership and definitions for trustworthy metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team argues over metrics and lacks a trusted data source

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你为数据定负责人、统一指标定义、检查数据质量、设置访问权限,并梳理数据血缘(来龙去脉)。若不同团队对同一指标说法不一,它会先引导你们把定义对齐,而不是急着定政策。
howto.when: 当团队间指标对不上、不知该用哪个数据集作准,或要设置数据归属与访问权限等治理问题时触发。

say.text: 我们团队对“活跃用户”的定义不一样,帮我整理一份指标字典。
say.note: 它会引导你写清定义、计算、负责人与已知局限。

say.text: 这张订单表好像缺了最近几天的数据,帮我检查一下数据质量。
say.note: 它会按新鲜度、行数、重复、空值等项逐项检查。

say.text: 我要把客户数据开放给市场部,帮我设置访问权限。
say.note: 它会先补上所有权、质量检查等开放前的准备。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you assign each dataset a named owner, align metric definitions, inspect data quality, set access, trace lineage, and reconcile metric conflicts by aligning definitions first rather than policy.
howto.when_en: Use when metrics disagree between teams, when the authoritative dataset is unknown, or when setting up data ownership or access policy — and similar governance situations.

say_en.text: Our teams define 'active customer' differently; help me draft a metric dictionary.
This order table seems to be missing recent days; run a data-quality check.
say_en.note: Checks freshness, row count, duplicates, and nulls.

say_en.text: I want to share customer data with marketing; help set access rules.
say_en.note: Prepares ownership and quality before opening.
